basis: Hand-set from one Mac M4 (the heavy GPU scene in 0.8 ms) and one software renderer (67 ms). CPU re-based at v0.1a: the kernel now flies the 6-DOF Kestrel hands-off, crashes and respawns included, which runs at 0.41 of the v0.0b spectator kernel on the same machine (WASM single under Node on the M4: 137 000 against 333 000 ticks per second), so the three CPU thresholds were scaled by 0.41 and every machine keeps its tier. To be tuned against the reference-machine reports (OQ-01, AC-60.6).

cpu.unit: kernel ticks per second on one thread, higher is better

gpuHeavyMs.unit: milliseconds per frame with 64 patches at 1080p, lower is better

gpuPresetMs.unit: milliseconds per frame with 64 patches at 1080p: the slowest each preset may be

memoryGb.unit: navigator.deviceMemory, which browsers round and cap (8 in the specification; headless Chrome 156 reported 16): memory can fail a machine but cannot rank it above Minimum
